lines: 第1章被师尊扫地出门了“陈长安。”
“你走吧！”
走？
陈长安看向面前一身紫色长裙，气质高贵，容貌绝美的漂亮师父，眼神之中满是不解。
“师父，这是为何？”
“弟子还想要陪伴在师父左右，弟子不舍得离开您啊。”陈长安不舍得说道。
听闻此话，漂亮师父那绝美的面容也是有些动容。
但这绝对不是感动，而是在强烈的压制住自己心中的厌烦。
“一万年！”
“整整一万年！”
“你可知为师这一万年是怎么过的？”漂亮师父冷声问道。
“当然知晓。”
“这一万年来，师父有我的陪伴，免去了一个人的孤独，自然是开心快乐，天天被幸福包围的一万年！”陈长安笑着说道。
开心？
快乐？
还被幸福包围？
呸！
牧云谣看着笑容满面的陈长安，恨不得一巴掌直接拍过去！
一万年前，牧云谣偶然之间发现了年仅六岁的陈长安，见对方体质奇特前所未见，便起了收徒的心思。
却不曾想，这竟然是自己噩梦的开始！
陈长安确实体质特殊，而且十分的聪慧！
牧云谣所教的东西，只需要一遍，陈长安便可以熟记于心，然而……
随着时间一点点的过去，牧云谣发现，不管陈长安怎么修炼，竟然都无法突破，甚至连入门都不行！
既然已经收为弟子，牧云谣就不能坐视不理，随即便将自己毕生所学，全部传授给陈长安。
陈长安不负众望，将牧云谣毕生所学，完全学会，但只是背了下来，却依然无法修炼。
牧云谣更是找遍了天下所有的珍贵的天材地宝，但最终也是徒劳！
牧云谣最终不得不放弃，本想着让陈长安平平安安的陪在自己身边走完这一生，谁曾想，这小子不老不死……
若是乖巧懂事也就罢了，偏偏他是个闲不住的主，这一万年，牧云谣过的是水深火热，终于忍耐不住，想要将陈长安赶走。
“师父……你当真要让我离开？”
陈长安见牧云谣的表情十分的认真，不由得也是脸色一变。
毕竟从六岁开始和牧云谣相处了一万年，之前从未想过会和师父分开！
“走吧，你已经留在这里一万年了，该走了。”
见陈长安神情落寞，牧云谣也有些不忍，但理智告诉自己，这个兔崽子，必须赶紧滚蛋！
“师父，弟子跟在您身边已经万年，如今举目无亲，无依无靠，天下虽大，却没有我容身之处了啊！”陈长安动情的说道。
content_en:
Chapter 1: Being kicked out by Master "Chen Changan."
"Let's go!"
Go?
Chen Changan looked at the beautiful master in front of him who was wearing a purple dress, with noble temperament and beautiful appearance, his eyes were full of confusion.
"Master, why is this?"
"I still want to stay with Master. I don't want to leave you." Chen Changan said reluctantly.
After hearing this, the beautiful master's beautiful face was also a little moved.
But this is definitely not moved, but a strong suppression of the boredom in his heart.
"Ten thousand years!"
"Exactly ten thousand years!"
"Do you know how you have spent these ten thousand years as a master?" the beautiful master asked coldly.
"Of course I know."
"For these ten thousand years, Master has been with me, eliminating the loneliness of being alone. Naturally, I am happy and surrounded by happiness every day for ten thousand years!" Chen Changan said with a smile.
happy?
hapiness?
Still surrounded by happiness?
Pooh!
Mu Yunyao looked at Chen Changan who was smiling and wanted to slap him!
Ten thousand years ago, Mu Yunyao accidentally discovered Chen Changan, who was only six years old. Seeing that Chen Changan had a strange physique that he had never seen before, he started to think of taking a disciple.
But he never thought that this would be the beginning of his nightmare!
Chen Changan does have a special physique and is very smart!
Chen Changan could memorize what Mu Yunyao taught him only once, but...
As time passed little by little, Mu Yunyao discovered that no matter how hard Chen Changan practiced, he could not break through, and he could not even get started!
Now that he had been accepted as a disciple, Mu Yunyao could not sit idly by and taught Chen Changan everything he had learned throughout his life.
Chen Changan lived up to expectations and fully learned what Mu Yunyao had learned throughout his life. However, he only memorized it, but still could not practice it.
Mu Yunyao even searched for all the precious materials and treasures in the world, but in the end it was all in vain!
Mu Yunyao had to give up in the end. He originally wanted to let Chen Changan stay by his side for the rest of his life. Who would have thought that this kid would never grow old or die...
It would be fine if he was well-behaved and sensible, but he was a restless master. In the past ten thousand years, Mu Yunyao had been in dire straits, and finally couldn't bear it anymore and wanted to drive Chen Changan away.
"Master... do you really want me to leave?"
Chen Changan couldn't help but change his expression when he saw that Mu Yunyao's expression was very serious.
After all, I have been with Mu Yunyao for ten thousand years since I was six years old. I never thought I would be separated from my master before!
"Let's go, you've been here for ten thousand years, it's time to go."
Seeing Chen Changan's lonely expression, Mu Yunyao couldn't bear it, but rationally told himself that this bastard must get out of here!
"Master, I have been with you for thousands of years. Now I have no friends and no one to rely on. Although the world is huge, there is no place for me!" Chen Changan said emotionally.
